contracts.listIntro: Prices you have agreed with a supplier for a period or a volume. Order against them any time without a new quote. Contracts are private between you and the supplier.
contracts.emptyDescription: Agree prices once with a supplier you already work with, then order against them whenever you need.
contracts.newIntro: Set the items, prices and period. It stays a private draft until you send it. The supplier can accept it, suggest changes or decline. It applies only when both of you have accepted.
contracts.quoteUnavailable: That quote cannot be converted. Start a contract from scratch instead.
contracts.quotePrefilled: Filled in from your accepted quote. Check every field, add the other items and the period you want, then create the draft.
contracts.title: Rate contract {number}
contracts.draftIntro: This draft is private to you. Send it to the supplier when it is ready.
contracts.waitingForSeller: Waiting for the supplier to answer. The prices below do not apply until they accept.
contracts.expiredNote: This contract has ended and does not renew by itself. You can start a renewal; both sides have to accept it.
contracts.terminatedReason: Ended by the {role}: {reason}. Orders already placed are not affected.
contracts.terminated: This contract has ended. Orders already placed are not affected.
contracts.endsSoon: {days, plural, =0 {This contract ends today} one {This contract ends in # day} other {This contract ends in # days}}. It will not renew by itself.
contracts.notStarted: This contract starts on {date}. You can order from that day.

usage.valueUncapped: Ordered so far: {used} before tax, no value limit.

contracts.reviseIntro: A change becomes a new revision that the supplier must accept. Until then the terms in force stay as they are. Orders already placed keep the price they were placed at.
contracts.renewalOf: This is a renewal of an earlier contract. Open it.

basis.for_destination: Delivered to your destination, freight extra

summary.termsValue: {days, plural, =0 {On delivery} one {# day after goods are accepted} other {# days after goods are accepted}}

variation.indexedValue: Indexed, may move up to {cap}% either way ({note})

form.quantityCapHint: Most you can order in total
form.variationCapHint: Up or down from the contract price
form.variationNoteHint: For example the monthly average of a published index
form.title: Contract name
form.supplierNone: Suppliers you have worked with on this site appear here.
form.changeNoteHint: Shown to the supplier and in the history
form.termsHint: Days after goods are accepted; 0 for on delivery
form.propose: Send the change to the supplier

terminate.title: End this contract
terminate.note: Ending is final and the other party is told. Orders already placed are not affected.

renew.title: Renew
renew.note: This creates a new draft with the same items and prices for a later period. Nothing renews by itself: you send it and the supplier accepts it again.

calloff.title: Order against {number}
calloff.unavailable: You cannot order against this contract right now. It must be active and inside its dates.
calloff.intro: Prices are locked by the contract. Enter a quantity for each item you need; leave the others empty. This contract is valid until {to}.
calloff.addressNone: Add a delivery address before you order.
calloff.nothingLeft: Every item on this contract has reached its quantity limit.
calloff.indexedHint: Indexed price: may differ from the contract price by up to {cap}
calloff.note: This places the order and a purchase order with the supplier at the contract prices. They still accept or reject the purchase order.

orderPanel.title: Rate contract
orderPanel.convertNote: Turn the accepted quote into a rate contract, so the price is agreed for a period and you can order again without a new quote.
